body:
Fixes #522.

`SplitMemoryLinks` now finds links with an internal source and an external target when using its default source linked list. Exact enumeration, counting, and `SearchOrDefault` agree with `UnitedMemoryLinks`; `GetOrCreate` returns the existing link.

### Reproduction and cause

Create point 1, then link 2 with source 1 and target `new Hybrid<ulong>(20, isExternal: true).Value` (18446744073709551596). Asking for `[any, 1, externalTarget]` should find link 2: `any` leaves the link's own ID unrestricted.

| Operation on the split store | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read link 2's source and target directly | Correct stored values | Correct stored values |
| `Each(any, 1, externalTarget)` | `[]` | `[2]` |
| `Count(any, 1, externalTarget)` | `0` | `1` |
| `SearchOrDefault(1, externalTarget)` | `0` | `2` |

An index is a lookup table for finding links by their endpoints. The united store keeps data and index metadata in one memory region, with store-wide source and target trees. The split store separates data from metadata and selects indexes using the configured external-reference range. Its default internal-source index is a linked list; external targets have a store-wide target tree.

The stored link was correct, but both exact-query branches searched the external **source** tree. That tree indexes external sources, so it had no entry for source 1. The two branches now search the external **target** tree, which contains link 2. The source-tree configuration already chose a suitable internal tree and continues to pass.

As requested, I studied [doublets-rs PR #75](https://github.com/linksplatform/doublets-rs/pull/75), including its C# comparison. Rust chooses internal/external indexes based on whether an ID exists, so its repair moves entries when an ID is created. C# chooses by a configured address range; this failure needs only the two corrected tree selections.

### Tests and release preparation

- Added 20 regression cases. Before the fix, all 12 linked-list cases failed while eight source-tree controls passed. All 20 now pass.
- Separate cases verify `Each`, `Count`, and `SearchOrDefault` with `byte`, `ushort`, `uint`, and `ulong` addresses, default settings, and recursive/recursionless size-balanced trees with source lists or trees.
- Full-scan comparisons cover all four internal/external endpoint combinations, absent pairs, wildcard queries, `Break` callbacks, endpoint changes, deletion, ID reuse, and `GetOrCreate`.
- Added a [runnable united/split example and explanation](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/tree/issue-522-2819acda0f21/examples/ExternalReferences). Both stores now print `Each -> [2], Count -> 1, SearchOrDefault -> 2` on .NET 8 and .NET 10.
- Prepared NuGet patch version **0.18.2** and release notes; packing produces the package and symbols successfully.
- Enabled the C# workflow on pull requests, including the example, with .NET 8 setup and finite hang/job limits. Publishing and documentation jobs run only on main pushes. Updated retired action versions and the deprecated workflow output command in that workflow.

### Validation

```sh
dotnet test csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets.sln -c Release -f net8 --blame-hang-timeout 3m
dotnet test csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets.Tests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~SplitMemoryExternalReferencesTests
dotnet run --project examples/ExternalReferences -c Release
dotnet pack csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets -c Release --no-build
```

Local validation: .NET 8.0.427 full solution run **40 passed, 1 existing skipped test** (`ScopeTests.FullAutoResolutionTest`, already marked “Would be fixed later.”). The focused regressions also pass on SDK 10.0.112/runtime 10.0.12. The example passes on both runtimes. Package contents confirm version 0.18.2, the updated release notes, and README. `actionlint`, all Markdown rules for the example README, and `git diff --check` pass. Existing compiler/documentation/package warnings remain.

On commit `f06746345dbd8024127517c6ae20b722f372c381`, [C# CI run 40671503061](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40671503061) passes the full suite and example; release/documentation jobs are correctly skipped on the PR. [Auto-merge workflow run 40671500003](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40671500003) also passes. [Codacy static analysis](https://app.codacy.com/gh/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/pull-requests/523) passes with zero new issues. Current main is included, the complete PR diff has been reviewed, and the working tree is clean.
